structuredResult.summary: Implemented demo.LinkBook in src/main/java/demo/LinkBook.java. It preserves fixed destinations, permanently reserves created codes, treats now >= expiresAt as expired, excludes HEAD and unsuccessful resolutions from counts, retains counts after disable/delete, and records total plus UTC daily counts. pom.xml and the supplied acceptance test were not modified. mvn verify was run but failed during Maven plugin resolution before compilation/tests because the sandbox blocked Maven’s user-repository tracking-file write; no independent Maven verification pass is claimed.
risks: Compilation and acceptance tests were not reached by Maven, so the independent verification and final human approval gates remain outstanding.
